label: PF Backlog 528
title: Auto-sync global OpenCode commands byte-for-byte on setup + a precheck drift guard
body:
## Problem / why
The global commands (.opencode/command_global/*.md) must be installed to ~/.config/opencode/command/ and kept byte-identical, but there was NO sync step (manual copy only) — which is why wg.md drifted (LF vs CRLF). Guards existed only per-file (pf/wg surface checks).

## Goal & value
One sync tool that installs/refreshes every command_global/*.md byte-for-byte, is called automatically by install.py, and a generic --check guard in precheck that FAILS on drift (skips when not installed -> CI-safe).

delivery.note: sync_global_commands.py (byte-for-byte) + install.py auto-call + precheck 'global-commands' guard. merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: No automated install/sync for global commands -> they drift (wg.md did).
brief.what_adds: sync_global_commands.py (sync + --check), auto-run from install.py, + a precheck gate.
brief.why: The installed command is the live one; drift means the wrong version runs.

objective: Add scripts/dev/sync_global_commands.py (byte-for-byte sync from .opencode/command_global/ to ~/.config/opencode/command/, + --check drift guard), auto-call it from install.py, and wire a global-commands precheck gate.
acceptance_criteria: sync copies every command_global/*.md to the install dir byte-for-byte (idempotent, cross-platform)
--check exits 1 on installed-copy drift; skips (exit 0) when not installed (CI-safe)
install.py runs the sync automatically on setup
approach: Byte-copy each command_global/*.md into ~/.config/opencode/command/ (os.makedirs + shutil.copyfile); --check compares bytes and exits 1 on drift (skip if absent); call from install.py; precheck gate runs --check.

prior_decisions: command_global is the installed SSOT (byte-identical rule)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/global_orchestrator.py, core/guardrails.py, core/repo_setup.py, core/run_guard.py

_note: Delivered + validated (sync --check OK, 2 tests pass, wired-audit unwired 0, lint 0 NEW)
